cohort: The study included women aged 18-40 years with uncomplicated pregnancies who experienced spontaneous labor and vaginal delivery between 37 0/7 and 42 0/7 weeks' gestation, with the primary cohort being 86% Hispanic.
finding: In a predominantly Hispanic cohort, GBS colonization was not associated with early-term delivery or lower birth weight, which contrasts with prior findings in African-American and Caucasian populations.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight for GBS+ was 3388.5g (+-388.6) and for GBS- was 3395.1g (+-401.7).
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery for GBS+ was 275.9 days (+-6.8) and for GBS- was 275.6 days (+-6.9); the study included deliveries between 37 0/7 and 42 0/7 weeks' gestation.
